lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Dense arrangement of high-luminance circular spots forming an approximately rectangular grid across the lateral flank. Spot density is highest toward the dorsal ridge and becomes more sparse and smaller toward the ventral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated pixel intensity align with the circular blobs, creating a series of grid-like anchor nodes along the mid-lateral line.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, showing a sharp luminance transition with light-saturated pixels on the upper surface and a shadow-defined gradient below.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, dark, elongated pixel clusters (likely remoras) attached to the lower lateral flank and the trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
